title: Research OS v1
description: Small current-state ledger; command envelopes are validated before atomic updates.

Ref.description: Canonical id of a record or event. Never an alias. Never a Handoff id.

Source.description: Who or what produced a value. Says nothing about authority.

from.description: For inherited/derived: the record the value came from (e.g. Project id).

Authority.description: The only allowed shape for authority. Authority binds to a record version, never to a single field.

policy.description: id of an active Policy whose scope and permits cover this act.

ApprovalRecord.description: Proof of a human act. quote is the human's verbatim words.

channel.description: Where the human said it, e.g. chat session id.

Scope.description: Key -> non-empty list of values. Two scopes overlap iff they share >=1 key and every shared key's lists intersect.

view.description: The table this experiment fills. Required before the contract can be authorized (A1).

Slot.description: Position of a Run in its experiment, e.g. {stage: eval, pretrain: c, task: T2, seed: '3'}. A newer Run in the same slot supersedes the older one.

ViewSpec.description: Structure of an experiment's table. Cell (r, c) holds the Runs whose slot equals cell.match + {rows.key: r, cols.key: c} (+ {replicates.key: v} for each replicate). Display text lives in experiment_view_styled, outside the contract.

row_model.description: Slot filter (plus {rows.key: r}) for the Runs whose checkpoint the row label links to.

HFRef.description: A pinned Hugging Face object: repo plus the 40-hex commit revision.

RunCapture.description: Filled by the `research run` wrapper. Never typed by hand.

Event.description: Transient CLI command envelope; only current authorization records are retained in the ledger.

subject.description: Record this event creates or changes. For *_created/*_proposed/*_started/*_granted(policy)/project_initialized it is the new record's id.

experiment_kinds.description: Committed contracts of these kinds are authorized if they satisfy constraints.

constraints.description: e.g. {primary_metric, baseline, max_gpu_hours}. A contract outside these is not covered.

resolution.description: Claims that are supported/refuted, or Decisions that are made.

view.description: Only for kind = dataset, which has no contract (R38).

contract.description: Full replacement. This event_id becomes the new contract version; prior grants no longer apply.

decision_rule_result.description: Required for committed experiments (checked by `research validate`).

subject_version.description: event_id of the latest content-defining event of the subject.

requested.description: e.g. {} for a contract, {to: 'supported'} for a claim, {to: 'valid'} for a run.

depends_on.description: Upstream Runs this Run consumes (e.g. the training Run whose checkpoint it evaluates).

supersedes.description: The Run in the same slot this one replaces (its parent).

products.description: Outputs that must be recorded as HFRef before the Run is completed.

P_run_planned.description: Reserves a slot; code is bound later, at run_started.

P_run_started.description: Starts a planned Run (subject = its id; plan fields omitted) or creates and starts one directly (plan fields optional).

P_run_resumed.description: Restart/resume the same committed code and inputs.

DatasetCard.description: Dataset-wide target and evidence-backed publication snapshot; independent of how many production Runs are registered.

DatasetResult.description: Evidence-backed dataset counts and pinned publication, recorded after execution without changing capture metrics or validity.

P_view_style.description: Display-only text for an experiment's view. Not part of the contract; needs no authority.

P_view_extended.description: Appends values to the view's axes (R44). Existing values, keys, match and metric never change. Needs A6 unless kind = dataset.

validity.description: valid iff status=succeeded and capture_gaps is empty.

capture_gaps.description: Mechanical facts the wrapper could not capture.

context.description: Motivating scout/debug refs. Never counted as support.

context_excluded.description: What the verifier was not given, e.g. producer_handoff.

Objects.description: Current records in ledger.json. Git preserves revisions; HF holds execution history.

authority.description: derived: authority valid for the current contract version.

legacy.description: marked by experiment_marked_legacy; excluded from views

view.description: derived: the contract's (or a dataset's) view plus every experiment_view_extended

view_extended.description: derived: axis -> values appended since the view was last set

status.description: Exit 0 is completed once every declared product is recorded; nonzero exit or run_interrupted is interrupted.

needs_rerun.description: derived: invalid itself, or a dependency needs a rerun

deprecation_reason.description: derived: reason of the latest change to invalid

verified.description: derived: a consistent_with_evidence verification exists for the current version.

evidence_degraded.description: derived: some run in the evidence closure is not valid.

support_broken.description: derived: remaining valid evidence no longer satisfies AGENTS.md R27.

active.description: derived: not revoked and not expired.

PendingAuthority.description: Row of the generated `research pending-authority` view. Never stored.

stale.description: true if subject_version is no longer the current version.

Handoff.description: WORKSTATE/handoff/<HS-alias>.json. Zero epistemic weight. Never referenced by any event.

HFEvidence.description: A pinned Hugging Face object: repo plus the 40-hex commit revision.

HFTarget.description: A pinned Hugging Face object: repo plus the 40-hex commit revision.
